issues.description: The Stock API method for adding a StockIngredient is named inconsistently across artifacts: the problem statement (UML) specifies addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), the solution implements addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template provides addItem(StockIngredient) instead. This naming mismatch can prevent students from implementing SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery or from compiling code if they follow the UML/solution naming while using the provided template Stock class.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across template and UML/solution. Rename the template's addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a delegating method addToStockIngredients that calls addItem, so students can follow the problem statement and solution without compilation errors.
